claims.text: Higher-quality prompt engineering skills predict higher quality LLM output.
Certain aspects of AI literacy play a role in achieving higher quality prompt engineering.
A skill-based approach to prompt engineering can be used to evaluate non-experts' AI literacy and prompt engineering skills.

evidence.description: Results show that higher-quality prompt engineering skills predict the quality of LLM output.
Results show that certain aspects of AI literacy play a role in higher quality prompt engineering and targeted adaptation of LLMs within education.
The authors introduce a skill-based approach to prompt engineering, explicitly considering non-experts' AI literacy in higher education.

methodologies.name: Skill-based prompt engineering assessment and qualitative behavioral analysis
methodologies.description: A skill-based approach examining non-experts' (students) AI literacy, prompt engineering skills, and qualitative intuitive behaviors towards LLM-based AI systems.

limitations.text: Research on non-experts' perspectives when using LLM-based AI systems via prompt engineering and how AI literacy affects prompting behavior is lacking.

future_work.text: Integration of AI educational content into current educational curricula to enable students to effectively use generative AI tools like ChatGPT.
